upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_enabled: Master toggle for all VR-specific optimizations. Requires Vivecraft.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_temporal: Keep separate history buffers for left and right eye. Prevents cross-eye ghosting.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_temporal_clamp: How much to trust history vs current frame (0.02-0.25). Lower = more stable, less detail.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_auto_res: Automatically scale internal resolution based on combined stereo GPU work.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_target_fps: Target framerate for auto-resolution (matches headset refresh rate).
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_framegen: Generate intermediate frames using predicted HMD pose. Disables built-in flat frame gen in VR.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_framegen_hmd: Warp frames using predicted headset pose from Vivecraft/OpenXR.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_framegen_hands: Capture and composite controller/hands at native framerate to avoid reprojection artifacts.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_framegen_warp_angl: Skip generated frame if warp exceeds this angle (prevents distortion).
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_hide_overlay: Hide the 2D performance panel when in VR mode.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_project_overlay: Placeholder for future wrist/menu overlay projection.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_foveated: Reduce peripheral resolution/shading. Currently a parameter stub.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_foveated_radius: Central high-detail region radius in degrees.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_foveated_transitio: Transition zone from full to minimum detail in degrees.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_foveated_min_scale: Minimum resolution scale at edge of lens.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_vulkan_safe: Avoid descriptor pool/swapchain deadlocks on double present (left+right eye).
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_mobile_light: Reduce texture fetches, disable RCAS, use bilinear only for Adreno/Mali GPUs.
upshift_vr.tooltip.vr_report: Log current VR state to console and chat.
